title: The wrong things in the hopper
about: The feeding guide says what the worms get: vegetable and fruit scraps, coffee grounds, tea, eggshell; a little citrus, onion and bread; never meat, dairy, oil or cooked food. The robot cannot taste. You say what you put in the hopper, and it refuses a load that breaks the guide instead of carrying it to the worms.

steps.title: You: a plate's leftovers go in
steps.why: 1 kg in the hopper: half of it vegetable scraps, but also 200 g of cooked leftovers and 300 g of orange peel. Two rules are broken: cooked food never, and citrus at most a tenth of a week's food.

steps.title: You: empty the hopper
steps.why: The notice at the top names what must not go in. The load goes to the ordinary bin or the municipal compost, not to the worms.

steps.title: You: a load by the guide
steps.why: 600 g vegetable scraps, 250 g fruit, 100 g coffee grounds, 50 g crushed eggshell (it keeps the box from turning sour).

do.label: Fill the hopper by the guide

steps.title: Robot: feed
steps.why: The scoop takes a share of everything in the hopper. The feeding goes into the diary with what it was made of; the Worm box panel shows the week.
